content: The sun rises and sets, the seasons cycle endlessly, yet the fool remains asleep in the cradle of delusion.
author: Kabir
explanation: Time is quietly slipping away while we drift through life on automatic pilot. Kabir sounds the alarm to awaken into lucid presence before youth and vitality evaporate.
practicalInsight: Set an hourly reminder on your phone today to stop, look at the sky, and ask: 'Am I truly awake in this moment?'
reflectionPrompt: How many hours of my day am I sleepwalking through habitual daydreaming?
